name: Figma AI
tagline: AI-powered features built into your design workflow
description: Figma AI integrates generative AI directly into the Figma design platform. Features include First Draft (generate full UI layouts from a prompt), Make Designs (convert text to mockups), Rename Layers (auto-name layers intelligently), Visual Search (find similar components), and AI-powered prototyping suggestions. Figma AI is available to all Figma plans and uses a mix of proprietary and third-party AI models.
pricingDetails: Included in all Figma plans: Free (limited), Professional: $12/editor/month, Organization: $45/editor/month.
